paragraphs.text: Hi there :) This is Bam. Thanks for stopping by.
Usually I would introduce myself like: Hi, I’m Bramuda, I’m a former journalist turned SEO content writer who happens to write and direct films.
But every time I do that I feel like an automated answering machine. So unnecessarily firm and repetitive. So instead, i make this website to help introduce myself :D
As much as I love seeing my close ones making it in life, I believe failures and hard times are the ones making us truly whole. And here’s my favorite all time failure.
Up until the age of 15, I lived a classic future basketball athlete life trope. But I got badly injured in high school so there goes that dream :/
Who would’ve thought that the times I spent recovering rotting in bed led me to a new found love in film and poetry.
And now, I’ve made 5 short films that took me further than I’ve ever been. Hopefully, maybe someday, it can take me too🤞
